v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Salve, crux pretiósa, * súscipe discípulum eius, qui pepéndit in te magíster meus Christus.
text.en: God bless thee, precious cross, * be welcome to the follower of Him That hung on thee, even my Master Christ.

text.la: Beátus Andréas * orábat, dicens: Dómine, Rex ætérnæ glóriæ, súscipe me pendéntem in patíbulo.
text.en: The blessed Andrew prayed and said: * O Lord, King of everlasting glory, receive me hanging on this gallows.

text.la: Andréas Christi fámulus, * dignus Dei Apóstolus, germánus Petri, et in passióne sócius.
text.en: Andrew was the servant of Christ, * a worthy Apostle of God, the brother of Peter, and likened to Christ and to Peter in his death.

text.la: Maximílla Christo amábilis * tulit corpus Apóstoli, óptimo loco cum aromátibus sepelívit.
text.en: Christ's dear handmaid Maximilla took the body * of the Apostle and buried it with spices in an honourable place.

text.la: Qui persequebántur iustum, * demersísti eos, Dómine, in inférno, et in ligno crucis dux iusti fuísti.
text.en: O Lord, Thou hast caused them that persecuted the just to be swallowed up in hell, * but to the just Thou hast thyself shown the way on the tree of the cross.

text.la: Fratres: Corde enim créditur ad iustítiam, ore autem conféssio fit ad salútem. Dicit enim Scriptúra: Omnis, qui credit in illum, non confundétur.
text.en: Brothers: For, with the heart, we believe unto justice; but, with the mouth, confession is made unto salvation. For the scripture saith: Whosoever believeth in him, shall not be confounded.

v.en: They declared the works of God.

text.la: Concéde nobis * hóminem iustum, redde nobis hóminem sanctum: ne interfícias hóminem Deo carum, iustum, mansuétum et pium.
text.en: Spare unto us * this just man, release unto us this holy one; slay not the friend of God, who is just, courteous, and godly.

text.la: Maiestátem tuam, Dómine, supplíciter exorámus: ut, sicut Ecclésiæ tuæ beátus Andréas Apóstolus éxstitit prædicátor et rector; ita apud te sit pro nobis perpétuus intercéssor.
text.en: O Lord, we humbly beseech thy Majesty, that even as Thou didst give thy blessed Apostle Andrew to thy Church to be a teacher and a ruler on earth, so, now that he is with thee, he may continually make intercession for us.

title.la: Feria III infra Hebdomadam I Adventus
title.en: Feria III infra Hebdomadam I Adventus

text.la: Antequam convenírent, invénta est María habens in útero de Spíritu Sancto, allelúia.
text.en: Before they came together, Mary was found with child of the Holy Ghost. Alleluia.

v.la: Vox clamántis in desérto: Paráte viam Dómini.
v.en: A voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare the way of the Lord.

text.la: Excita, quǽsumus, Dómine, poténtiam tuam, et veni: ut ab imminéntibus peccatórum nostrórum perículis, te mereámur protegénte éripi, te liberánte salvári:
text.en: Stir up, O Lord, we pray thee, thy strength, and come among us, that whereas through our sins and wickedness we do justly apprehend thy wrathful judgments hanging over us, thy bountiful grace and mercy may speedily help and deliver us;
